parent_objective: design task-sampling calibration for terminal-boundary near-boundary rows before interventions
blocked_by: M1541 history interventions are null and control dominated
supersedes: rerunning terminal-boundary interventions on uncalibrated source rows

public_gates: M1543 must design calibration before rerunning interventions
M1543 must target actual simulator decision/post-decision margins
M1543 must preserve the P0 actor input contract
M1543 must keep materialization and training blocked

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs a calibration route to generate actual near-boundary terminal target rows before another intervention smoke
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no candidate materialization, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if calibration would require actor-input changes
stop if calibration would use private holdout or export a training corpus
stop after defining bounded calibration artifacts and pass/fail thresholds
fallback_plan: route to branch synthesis if calibrated near-boundary rows are not possible with current simulator hooks
route to implementation only if the design keeps all guardrails and bounded public seeds
route to stop if the next calibration smoke repeats M1541's source-window miss
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1542 admits task-sampling calibration after M1541 source-window miss

admission_evidence: M1542 audited M1541 as a source-window miss rather than a materializable history-positive result
allowed_updates: M1543 status queue scoreboard research log and review
next_stage_criteria: calibration variables and bounded source grid are defined
decision-window and post-decision margin targets are defined
coverage and guardrail thresholds are defined

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1543 is design only; it must not claim history necessity from future calibrated rows.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: Design for calibrated decision and post-decision windows only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If calibrated rows cannot be produced, route to synthesis/stop instead of weakening thresholds.
allowed_claims: no promotion, training corpus export, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A bounded task-sampling calibration design can repair M1541's source-window miss by targeting actual fixed-policy terminal margins before another history-intervention run.
success_criteria: design defines calibration variables and pass/fail thresholds
design separates decision-window and post-decision margin targets
candidate materialization training PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and training-corpus export remain blocked
failure_criteria: design routes directly to interventions without calibrating actual margins
design changes actor inputs or weakens self-ID evidence standards
design routes directly to training promotion private holdout or materialization
decision_rule: M1543 passes if it designs a bounded calibration route for actual near-boundary terminal rows without weakening guardrails.
